notes.title: Performance Update
notes.content:
[b]Performance Improvements[/b]

・We have identified factors within Unity that are lowering performance, and have improved frame rates by up to 2~4 times.
Improved issues such as significant performance drops and crashes when running at resolutions higher than 1080P.
However, crashes due to environmental differences are still possible, in which case we recommend lowering the resolution.
(There was a bug that seemed to be a bug in Unity, so this has been fixed and reported.)


・The sharpness filter has been changed to a more effective filter.
With this change, the sharpness filter, which makes images sharper even when upscaling is not used, now available even when upscaling is not used.


・The character and camera control systems have been restored to improve performance.
As a result, the behavior of the camera, which would shake like a gaga gaga in the first elevator, has been improved.
The behavior of the camera shaking when getting up from the bed has also been improved.
The behavior where the camera would instantly drop when climbing over an object or falling from a height has also been improved.
Fixed an issue where the camera would get stuck when going to the top of a hill if too much time has passed in a flooded area.


・Various minor modifications.



[b]Remarks[/b]

After this update, if you are using extended resolution with DXR coefficients at startup, it may become unresponsive. If this happens, please disable the DXR factor from the Nvidia Control Panel and try to start up again.
If the program starts successfully, there should be no problem even if you enable the DXR coefficient from then on.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused (m_m)

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
[b]Additional Features[/b]

- Added a reticle that will be displayed in the center of the screen. Please choose your favorite sticker from the board installed in room 1028.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878333/4f63d8819858fa16032c3c60ca61ed4625eae3b3.png[/img]

[b]Adjustments[/b]

- Increased the brightness of the light illuminating in front of the player by approximately 2 times to improve visibility.
- Reduced the time it takes for the elevator doors to reopen from 13.8 seconds to 8.7 seconds.
- Lowered the difficulty level in the laser stage.
- Removed the event involving the collective (lotus).
- Extended the time it takes for the player to reach the lethal zone in the flooded area by approximately 50 seconds.
- Fixed an issue where the Furious Oak's occurrence was delayed at specific timings, reducing the time available to escape.
- Reduced the loading time for room 1028.


Thank you for playing ATTA!!!
By the way, 'ATTA' means 'I found it!' in Japanese!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update Note #1
notes.content:
[b]- Difficulty -[/b]
EASY: Decrease in the types of mistakes
STANDARD: Normal difficulty
STANDARD+: Increase in the number of mistakes
THROUGH: No mistakes occur, only events happen. Clear time is not recorded.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878333/7b94d87d95902eef56970e8797975ba0b006e4e3.png[/img]


[b]- Improvements -[/b]
Changed the explanation text of the rules to be more detailed.
After this update, sleeping in Room 1028 will skip the prologue when restarting the game.
Fixed an issue where attempting to read the researcher's diary twice in a row could cause a freeze.
Various other minor fixes and adjustments were made.

Thank you very much for playing!
We sincerely apologize to those who have been inconvenienced. m(_)m
